body:
Context reads now reuse a guarded collection descriptor for consecutive candidates
while retaining every current source, version, validation and byte-budget check.
Balanced release comparisons save 3.2–3.4 ms for 37 cards and 16.9–18.9 ms for
1,000 ordinary/rich cards. Two later long-body pairs save about 18 ms after an
unstable first pair. All 720 selected observations pass identity/version/budget
checks and full normalized outputs match. Initial measurements affected by
independent test work are not acceptance evidence.

The 467-test full gate and normally paired Chromium/WebKit protocol checks pass
before and after incorporating the independently verified motion UI. The existing
HTTPS app is rebuilt and restarted, preserving all 76 prior resource versions,
three pins, preferences, certificate, instance/epoch and complete native CLI
context; all 32 served assets match the rebuilt frontend. Both owner card changes
remain separate. Broader perceived performance, Linux widget/QML, physical iPhone
and release acceptance remain open. See progress/2026-10-01-context-candidate-reads.md.

metadata.summary: Scoped context reads reduce repeated filesystem traversal
